hook: *17 days* of evening diversions near Indira Park
hook_b: *17 days* of evening diversions near Indira Park
tldr: Hyderabad Traffic Police announced diversions around NTR Stadium from November 14 to 30 for the Koti Deepotsavam event.

beats.what: Traffic from Telangana Thalli flyover towards Steel Bridge will be diverted at Katta Maisamma Temple via Dhobi Ghat, DBR Mills, Gandhi Nagar, Kavadiguda, CGO Towers and Musheerabad X Roads.
beats.why: Koti Deepotsavam is being held at NTR Stadium, and moderate congestion is expected in the surrounding roads.
beats.care: Vehicles from Ashok Nagar X Roads towards Katta Maisamma Temple go towards Himayatnagar; avoid RK Mutt Road and Indira Park X Roads.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Police also advise skipping the Banda Maisamma–Dharna Chowk and Indira Park–Ashok Nagar Nala stretches.
